scope: Actual packaged supervisor, framework password/data gates, real native map readiness and process/session lifecycle in isolated containers. WebSocket peer holds idle lifecycle but does not join as a native player; this is not a Chrome test. Bot-enabled profile also proves actual native roster, movement, bot archive integrity and empty sleep/rewake.
checks: supervisor session accepted by static child
missing owner data blocks native startup
missing data leaves no native process/session
private data path is not exposed
readiness includes two actual native bot brains
bot readiness reports a complete fresh frame
packaged bot archive is available to the authorized worker
browser relay peer prevents idle shutdown
relay connection accounted separately from native roster
real bot frames stay fresh during live play
both native bots move more than 64 units after readiness
idle sleep cleans child and temporary session
bot presence does not hold idle lifecycle
sleeping match never reports bots as starting
new native process recreates both bot brains after idle
unexpected child exit cleans temporary session
failed startup can be attempted again
